headline: Add FX service and enable cross-currency payment conversion
summary: Introduces the Fx module with FxService to compute exchange rates and rounded conversions across EUR, SEK, and USD. Updates PaymentService, the Payment entity, and the Payments table to record credited amounts, credited currencies, and exchange rates while removing the currency mismatch rejection.
business: Customers can transfer funds between accounts in EUR, SEK, and USD using fixed exchange rates rounded to two decimals away from zero, and repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the existing payment.

reasons.text: Missing test coverage for PaymentService cross-currency flows and EUR daily limits
reasons.claim: The acceptance criteria explicitly require automated xUnit tests covering cross-currency PaymentService flows (verifying FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, Rate) and EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement. However, FxTests only tests FxService in isolation and directly invokes ILedger without exercising PaymentService.PayAsync or daily transfer limit calculations.
reasons.suggested_fix: Add test methods to Bank.Tests that instantiate PaymentService and call PayAsync across currencies to verify: (1) payer debited to FxClearing, (2) payee credited from FxClearing, (3) Payment entity properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, and Rate, and (4) rejection when daily payments exceed DailyTransferLimit in EUR equivalent.
reasons.say: Cross-currency transfers and daily EUR limits in PaymentService have no automated tests, risking wrong balances or bypassed limits. Ask for tests exercising the full payment flow to verify clearing entries, limits, and saved values.
reasons.say_facts: The acceptance criteria explicitly require automated xUnit tests covering cross-currency PaymentService flows (verifying FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, Rate) and EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement. Ask for a fix before merging.

reasons.detail: Customers can transfer funds between accounts in EUR, SEK, and USD using fixed exchange rates rounded to two decimals away from zero, and repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the existing payment.
reasons.say: Customers can transfer across EUR, SEK, and USD with fixed rates and duplicate-payment protection, directly affecting balances. Check that rate calculations, rounding, and duplicate-request handling are thoroughly verified before approving.
reasons.say_facts: This change has a high impact on customers or money: Customers can transfer funds between accounts in EUR, SEK, and USD using fixed exchange rates rounded to two decimals away from zero, and repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the existing payment. Confirm the business owner agrees.

reasons.text: Unrequested PaymentService constructor tightly couples to concrete FxService
reasons.claim: PaymentService adds a redundant 7-parameter constructor overload that directly instantiates 'new FxService()'. This violates YAGNI and dependency inversion principles, and introduces constructor ambiguity for dependency injection containers.
reasons.suggested_fix: Remove the 7-parameter constructor overload so PaymentService relies solely on dependency injection for IFxService.
reasons.evidence:

        BankDbContext db,
        ILedger ledger,
        IAccountService accounts,
        ICurrentUser user,
        IClock clock,
        BankSettings settings,
        IEventBus bus)
        : this(db, ledger, accounts, user, clock, settings, new FxService(), bus)
    {
reasons.say: An extra PaymentService constructor hardcodes the currency service directly, which can break startup wiring or prevent swapping rates later. Ask to remove this unused constructor and rely on standard dependency injection.
reasons.say_facts: This violates YAGNI and dependency inversion principles, and introduces constructor ambiguity for dependency injection containers. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.claim: A validation/throw line was removed (old line 81) and not re-added. Repeated AI refinement is known to strip boundary checks.
reasons.suggested_fix: Confirm the check is no longer needed, or restore it.
reasons.say: A safety validation check was removed around line 81, which could allow invalid transfers or corrupted balances. Ask the author why this guard was deleted and confirm whether it must be restored.
reasons.say_facts: Repeated AI refinement is known to strip boundary checks. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: Redundant constructor tightly couples PaymentService to concrete FxService
reasons.claim: PaymentService defines an extra constructor overload that instantiates new FxService() directly as a default. This violates dependency inversion by coupling the service directly to the concrete FxService implementation instead of relying on the registered IFxService abstraction from dependency injection.
reasons.suggested_fix: Remove the 7-parameter constructor overload and ensure callers supply IFxService via the 8-parameter constructor.
reasons.evidence:
public PaymentService(
        BankDbContext db,
        ILedger ledger,
        IAccountService accounts,
        ICurrentUser user,
        IClock clock,
        BankSettings settings,
        IEventBus bus)
        : this(db, ledger, accounts, user, clock, settings, new FxService(), bus)
    {
    }
reasons.say: Another hardcoded constructor in PaymentService bypasses standard service registration, risking startup errors or inconsistent exchange rates. Ask the author to remove it so the service always uses the registered currency component.
reasons.say_facts: This violates dependency inversion by coupling the service directly to the concrete FxService implementation instead of relying on the registered IFxService abstraction from dependency injection. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: No test coverage for EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement in PaymentService
reasons.claim: PaymentService now converts historical same-day payments and the incoming payment request to EUR to validate against DailyTransferLimit. However, no automated tests exist to verify that cross-currency and multi-currency daily payment totals are correctly converted and that DailyLimitExceededException is thrown when the limit is breached.
reasons.suggested_fix: Add tests for PaymentService.PayAsync that record completed payments in non-EUR currencies and assert that attempting an additional payment that exceeds DailyTransferLimit in EUR equivalent throws DailyLimitExceededException.
reasons.say: Daily transfer limits converted to EUR are untested, so customers might exceed daily caps across currencies unnoticed. Ask for automated tests confirming multi-currency daily totals block payments once the limit is reached.
reasons.say_facts: However, no automated tests exist to verify that cross-currency and multi-currency daily payment totals are correctly converted and that DailyLimitExceededException is thrown when the limit is breached. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: PaymentService cross-currency payment execution and Payment properties are not tested
reasons.claim: Acceptance criterion 12 requires automated test coverage for cross-currency PaymentService flows including FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties. The test in FxTests calls ILedger.PostTransferAsync directly instead of calling PaymentService.PayAsync, leaving PaymentService's dual-leg ledger orchestration, cross-currency validations, and Payment entity field mapping completely unexercised.
reasons.suggested_fix: Add unit tests invoking PaymentService.PayAsync across different currencies (e.g. EUR to SEK, SEK to USD) that verify both ledger legs through BankAccounts.For(BankAccountKind.FxClearing, currency) and assert that CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, and Rate are correctly assigned and persisted.
reasons.say: Cross-currency tests bypass PaymentService and call the ledger directly, leaving clearing steps, validations, and recorded payment fields unverified. Ask for end-to-end service tests that verify the actual payment execution.
reasons.say_facts: Acceptance criterion 12 requires automated test coverage for cross-currency PaymentService flows including FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: 6 changed method(s) have no usable test evidence
reasons.say: Six changed methods covering currency conversion helpers, module setup, and service construction lack test evidence, risking hidden runtime failures. Check that test coverage includes these paths or confirm unnecessary constructors are removed.
reasons.say_facts: 6 changed parts of the code are not covered by any working test. Read them yourself or ask for tests.
